title: The payload of a signed FrontHost document

FrontHost.description: FrontHost is the kind FrontHost (0017 "Passkeys", 0035 "Passkeys and the relying-party ID"): the relying party of the passkey ceremonies and the web origins that may complete them. Keyed by the client it is for or `default`; session reads `default`. No document means passkeys are off.

rp_id.description: the relying-party ID: a lower-case host name (labels of 1 to 63 letters, digits and hyphens, at most 253 characters), the registrable parent of every web origin below; the loader also refuses an IP address, which the form does not state

origins.description: the web origins, scheme://host[:port], that an assertion or a registration may come from; nothing else is accepted (REQ-AUTHN-050, REQ-ISO-034). The form is the schema's: at most 16, none twice; that each is the rp_id or below it, has no default port and uses http only for localhost is the loader's.
